subject.title: Admin deletion request: remove three moderation-hidden test skills

question: Should authorized ClawHub staff approve irreversible hard deletion of the three moderation-hidden listings and their associated unavailable-version and discovery records?
rationale: The requested operation is an administrative, potentially irreversible moderation action whose retention and audit boundary cannot be inferred from the issue alone.

options.title: Approve audited hard deletion
options.body: Verify the requester’s ownership and moderation record, then permanently remove the three listings and associated stale discovery records under the staff procedure.

options.title: Preserve records under retention policy
options.body: Keep the listings hidden and explain the applicable retention or audit requirement if permanent removal is not authorized.

recommendation.title: Approve audited hard deletion
recommendation.body: Verify the requester’s ownership and moderation record, then permanently remove the three listings and associated stale discovery records under the staff procedure.

likelyOwner.reason: This is explicitly a moderator/admin hard-delete request rather than a code-path ownership decision.
